[spoiler=[b]Young Tallisland[/b]]

When the Fortress at Evraibal was first constructed on Tallisland, the Starzyddur people looked to be a powerful claimant to the region. Having slowly migrated down the coast of Elseyr from what is now the Neue Republik, the Starzyddur had come to rival the strength of the local Rechite hordes, and the Laddrzegian cities.

Eyjafjollum and Grimsdalr became wildly successful sea-powers, trade bringing great wealth to the undeveloped shores as the Szbulban Titanate struggled with internal politics. Even deeper in the mainland, Skraften had imbedded itself as a strong central-mountain nation

Things changed in 947 when Rechia's splintered tribal families were finally tempered, forming the Rechite Khaganate. The Khaganate flooded into the wealthy but undefended Kingdom of Skraften, seizing the wealthiest regions while the rest of the kingdom reformed into Varikseyk.

By 950, Eyjafjollum had won the War of the White-hut against Gdystok, seizing much of the territory for themselves. Grimsdalr however saw a great decline in trade power as the Szbulban Titanate reformed itself, like Rechia, into Great Szbulba. Revitalized, Szbulban piracy returned to the region, with Great Szbulba seizing land from both Eyjafjollum and Grimsdalr on their islands.

Economically weakened and distracted by Szbulba, the Laddrzegian cities began their encroachment on the Northern cities of Grimsdalr, making significant uncontested gains.

The decline of the city builders in Grimsdalr was becoming more and more exacerbated, culminating in the 1000 A.D Peace of Karvbrücken, which saw the northern half of Grimsdalr annexed by Laddrzeg, the western coast taken by Eyjafjollic traders, and Tylerek Island seized by Szbulba.

All the while, the Rechites gained power by signing a peace with the Tallislandic invaders, vassalizing the Varikseyk Kingdom to become the Varikseykr Chanat, and splitting ata between the two. Eyjafjollum however made itself into an empire, destroying the last Gdystok holdouts and integrating Grimsdalr territories.

By 1300 however, the Starzyddur era of domination was completely over. Grimsdalr was reduced to Ironlorkston, Eyjafjollum had lost all of it's major cities to Szbulba, and the Skraften had declared independence only to be vassalized by the Tallislandics. The faith brought to the region by the Starzyddur, Hellirinnism was all but extinct now, the Baptism of Zielenstadt converting Eyjafjollum's monarchy.

The Eyjafjollics had a revitalization in the 1500s, collaborating with the Tallislandics to crush the Rechite Khaganate once and for all, and to push the Szbulban Empire off of the mainland. This came at the cost of all of Grimsdalr falling to Tallisland, and the Skraften republicanization, setting the groundwork for their later integration.

Starzyddur independence concluded in 1791 when the Tallislandic Guard paraded through Thorning, destroying Eyjafjollum and beginning the integration of their culture. What wasn't taken by Tallisland was placed under the rulership of the Rechite-lead Gdostoczanin Republic, and the final nail in the coffin was the 1846 Constitution of the Holy Republic of Tallisland, which integrated the Szbulban Regency, the Gdostoczanin Republic, and the Skraften Republic.

Now, in 2026, the Starzyddur identity was fractured. Without an independent nation, robbed of their true faith, and subjugated under a group that waged war against them for decades. Combined, the Rechites and Starzyddur represented 53% of Tallisland's population, and accounted for only 28% of seats in Tallisland's government.

The system rewarded the "faithful," who were nine-tines-out-of-ten Cudzothko-Llyndorans who wore a cross on their neck. If there's one positive thing the Llyndorans did bring to these lands however, it was a skewed version of a Democracy, one that would give hope to those that were oppressed by the current government.

Kjersti Stennes was one of those who saw hope. Raised by an industrial family in the historical Starzyddur capital of Karwbridc, she was told countless stories of Starzyddur resistance as a child, her father arrested as a teenager for rioting for Grimsdalr independence. Coming from a poor background, Kjersti's parents pushed vehemently for her success, enrolling the girl in as many academics, sports, and extracurricular activities as possible to ensure that she succeeded in the system that her father despised.

And succeed Kjersti did. Straight-A grades, triathlon winner, and an-almost professional football player if not for her legal dreams. In her public secondary school is where she became close friends (and rumored lover) to Michał Krystian II Grabarczyk, an ethnically Szbulban aristocrat who used his wealth and connections to show Kjersti how irreligious and deplorable the elite of Tallisland were.

Continuing her studies, Stennes earned a college scholarship in the legal capital of Tallisland: Kranowo nad Bridgenay, becoming an esteemed lawyer and soon after, state prosecutor. In college is where she connected with other Starzyddur nationalists in the Eyjafjollic-built city, who even as a woman became a core founder of the extremist group Young Tallisland.

The foundation of Young Tallisland in 2011 was the culmination of decades of rising Anti-Lusandric sentiment. Slowly but surely since the creation of the internet, people learned of the atrocities committed by the Lusandric Church and how free those outside of the nation were. Young Tallisland was made up of many Starzyddur nationalists like Kjersti, but also had socialist Cudzothko like Kacper Watts, and many other diverse members. Young Tallisland was simply a militant group against the Lusandric domination of Tallislandic "democracy."

Young Tallisland's first major impression on the world was in 2017 when college student Colton Puławski constructed and detonated an improvised explosive device in the capital of Osliburne, killing four people. During his trial, Puławski declared his loyalty to Young Tallisland and took his own life with a sacrificial blade. That act prompted President Clifford Prisk to declare the group a terror cell, disbanding most major cells in colleges and forcing members underground.

While Stennes did not personally approve of the act, she continued to operate her own cell of Young Tallisland, eventually integrating into the government and gathering several Cudzothko, Starzyddur, and Rechite members of government to help the group rise to power. She and her followers became entirely devoted to ensuring true justice would reign throughout Tallisland, and that everyone in the nation would be able to vote for their own fate.

Now it is 2026. Kjersti and her old associate in college, Kacper Watts had both risen to become presidential candidates. Since 2020, a rift had grown between the two, and in Young Tallisland as a whole. Kjersti had advocated for total liberation of all across Erene, whereas those like Watts merely wanted more liberal policies and less harsh Lusandric law. Still reluctant allies, Stennes knew that divided Young Tallisland would not succeed, so she hid her displeasure.

For now.

[/Spoiler]
